fix.short_version:
At 7200 MT/s with 12 memory modules, the new read kernel (a benchmark loop with loads only) still read 29.7 % to 31.2 % less than the old read kernel (each load is followed by an add) in 8 pairs of 6 s measurements.
For the old read kernel, no difference from the earlier 8000 MT/s runs was seen in two of the three tests (parts A and C), and in the third (part L) it was lower by 0.3 % (nearest ends of the two ranges) and 1.3 % (medians).
The load-only loop gave higher rates than these 8000 MT/s runs in all 4 comparisons of the rerun (Table 2), and the data do not show that the memory speed caused either difference.
